changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Interpret UTC track timestamps in the requested calendar timezone. Keep year comparisons on the stored UTC column with exclusive upper bounds.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE filter_config SET expression = REPLACE( REPLACE(expression, 'to_char(gt.start_date,', 'to_char((gt.start_date AT TIME ZONE ''UTC'' AT TIME ZONE COALESCE(:FILTER_TIME_ZONE, ''UTC'')),'), 'from gt.start_date)', 'from (gt.start_date AT TIME ZONE ''UTC'' AT TIME ZONE COALESCE(:FILTER_TIME_ZONE, ''UTC'')))') WHERE filter_domain = 'GPS_TRACK' AND filter_name IN ('TracksByYear', 'TracksByDay', 'TracksByQuarter', 'TracksByDayOfWeek', 'TracksByTimeOfDay');
UPDATE filter_config SET expression = REPLACE( REPLACE(expression, 'make_date(CAST(NULLIF(BTRIM(:YEAR_FROM), '''') AS integer), 1, 1)', '(CAST(make_date(CAST(NULLIF(BTRIM(:YEAR_FROM), '''') AS integer), 1, 1) AS timestamp) AT TIME ZONE COALESCE(:FILTER_TIME_ZONE, ''UTC'') AT TIME ZONE ''UTC'')'), 'make_date(CAST(NULLIF(BTRIM(:YEAR_TO), '''') AS integer) + 1, 1, 1)', '(CAST(make_date(CAST(NULLIF(BTRIM(:YEAR_TO), '''') AS integer) + 1, 1, 1) AS timestamp) AT TIME ZONE COALESCE(:FILTER_TIME_ZONE, ''UTC'') AT TIME ZONE ''UTC'')') WHERE filter_domain = 'GPS_TRACK' AND filter_name = 'TracksByYear';
